items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I did Liza Minelli's "Cabaret" over there

ctx.x: But when I called to make this appointment to do this, they told me I wanted the publishing department.

Well, no. What I am here, I am the -- I'm in charge of all the budgets here, okay? All the recording budgets. So what happens if someone -- they get ready to go in the studio, they want to record, so they come in and they sit with me, and we go over the budget. Now if they want $85,000 in the budget, then my job is to show them if it shouldn't be but $65,000 ---so being a musician and having had the experience in the studio, then I can generally show it to them, and -- but not always. Sometimes maybe we will take…

But really my function here is -- it's more of an administrative thing.
